methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Blitzpanel is a pre-seed robotics and manufacturing company founded by Caleb Ho. The broader sector comprises 10 peers across robotics and manufacturing, including 1 public company (277810.KQ) and 8 private firms. Top private peers span the space include Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics, though stage and valuation dispersion across this set is substantial.

The peer-median triangulation method is not applicable here. Despite identifying 10 same-sector comparables, the narrow filters required for valuation—matching stage, adjacent stage, and similar valuation tier—yielded fewer than 3 datapoints in any single category. Applying an all-sector median would conflate pre-seed-stage capital requirements and risk profiles with growth-stage and late-stage robotics companies, introducing material distortion.

Without sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables and absent other methods documented in this dataset, a quantitative valuation range cannot be defensibly triangulated. Any valuation would require either: (1) deeper diligence into the 8 private peer financials to establish stage-appropriate benchmarks; (2) forward-looking metrics specific to Blitzpanel (runway, burn, product milestones); or (3) alternative methods such as venture capital method applied to projected cash flows. The analysis recommends supplementing peer analysis with founder experience, IP position, and market timing before establishing a valuation recommendation.
